source_review.definition: Minimize the order of a connected simple 4-regular graph with girth at least 10.
source_review.primary_source: Exoo et al. arXiv:2511.07247v2, including the reported (4,10) upper bound and the authors' graph data repository.
source_review.witness: The 320-vertex human witness was converted from the authors' n320_k4_g10.g6 record and is independently checked by the task evaluator.
source_review.independent_method: The evaluator recomputes graph order, regularity, connectedness, and girth. A feasible witness gives an upper bound; the cited source does not establish optimality.
source_review.baseline: The deterministic LPS X^(5,37) construction with two generator matchings removed is a 50,616-vertex feasible starting graph and does not read the human witness.
source_review.admission: T030-C01 was replayed and accepted by Sol. Its saved best construction remains an independently replayable task result.
